title: Fibroblastic disorders predicted effector genes (Weeks EM et al. 2023)
bodyHtml:
This table displays gene prioritization results for fibroblastic disorders, from the study:

Leveraging polygenic enrichments of gene features to predict genes underlying complex traits and diseases.
Weeks EM, Ulirsch JC, et al.
Nat Genet. 2023 Aug;55(8):1267-1276. doi: 10.1038/s41588-023-01443-6.
PMID: 37443254

The results displayed below were downloaded from the Finucane lab website.

The authors developed a similarity-based gene prioritization method, Polygenic Priority Score (PoPS), to generate a gene-level score reflecting the likelihood that a gene near a genetic association locus is the effector gene in the locus for that trait. They applied this method to GWAS summary statistics and fine-mapping results from the UK Biobank (Kanai et al., 2021) for multiple complex traits, along with 7 additional gene prioritization methods.

Mouse over the column headers for more details about each evidence type.
